description: East Riding of Yorkshire Controlled Parking Zonesv1 is a dataset listed in UK national open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by East Riding of Yorkshire Council. Controlled parking zones in the East Riding of Yorkshire. Although every attempt has been made to identify all such locations within the East Riding of Yorkshire there may be some that have been overlooked. Coverage: East Riding of Yorkshire Council. The portal files it under the publisher East Riding of Yorkshire Council. The portal shows 2026-07-08 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ckan-uk-portal.
